evals.prompt: Write a story under CHK01: as a signed-in customer I want to reach checkout with my cart so that I can buy.
evals.expected_output: A draft story with As a/I want/So that, independent test criterion, priority, and >=1 Gherkin scenario with observable Then. Offers append to TASKS.local.md or tracker create after confirmation.
assertions: Includes As a / I want / so that statement
Includes at least one Gherkin scenario with observable Then
Does not produce a full multi-story epic breakdown

evals.prompt: Add this story to specs/checkout-foundation/TASKS.local.md as the MVP.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing TASKS.local.md for numbering, appends ### S{n} as MVP when appropriate, reports path and story ID.
assertions: Reads the parent TASKS.local.md before choosing S{n}
Marks or states Story 1 / MVP when no prior stories exist or when asked
Appends to the epic TASKS.local.md rather than inventing a parallel file scheme
Does not silently create tracker issues

evals.prompt: Create a Jira story under epic CHK-10 with EARS as well as Gherkin.
evals.expected_output: Resolves Jira, drafts story with Gherkin plus EARS, creates under parent epic after confirmation (or immediately if create was explicit), uses CHK-10 linkage, no parallel internal ID.
assertions: Resolves tracker destination without hardcoding only one vendor forever
Includes both Gherkin and EARS when EARS requested
Uses tracker key as canonical ID
Parents the story to the epic
